scripts.check: concurrently --group "prettier --check ." "eslint . --no-cache -f unix" "tsc --noEmit --pretty false" "stylelint \"**/*.css\" -f unix --allow-empty-input --cache" "markdownlint-cli2 \"**/*.md\"" "textlint -f compact \"**/*.md\"" "knip --no-progress" "jscpd ." "tsc --noEmit --pretty false -p tsconfig.node.json" "node tools.mjs run actionlint" "cargo fmt --check" "cargo check --all-targets --features automation && cargo clippy --all-targets --features automation -- -D warnings" "cargo machete" "styling-lint check"
scripts.fix: concurrently -m 1 --group "prettier --write ." "eslint . --fix --cache" "stylelint \"**/*.css\" --fix --allow-empty-input --cache" "markdownlint-cli2 --fix \"**/*.md\"" "textlint --fix \"**/*.md\"" "cargo clippy --fix --allow-dirty --allow-staged --all-targets --features automation -- -D warnings" "cargo fmt" "styling-lint fix"
scripts.unit: concurrently --group "vitest run unit && node --test tools/release.unit.test.mjs" "cargo test --features probe"
scripts.prepare: node -e "const c=require('node:child_process');if(c.spawnSync('git',['rev-parse','--is-inside-work-tree'],{stdio:'ignore'}).status===0)c.execFileSync('git',['config','core.hooksPath','.githooks'])" && node tools.mjs install && cargo install styling-lint --version 0.1.0 --locked && cargo install cargo-machete --version 0.9.2 --locked
